start: Owner signed in, gym with two plans; Plans page

steps.action: Open Plans
user_sees: Title 'Plans', subtitle 'What you sell, and for how much'
Button '+ Add plan'
One row per plan: name, price, duration, joining fee line, 'Sold today, runs until {date}', Edit
must_not: Plans of another gym or branch
A run-until date that is a day short

steps.action: Tap '+ Add plan'
user_sees: Sheet 'Add plan'
Boxes 'Plan name', 'Duration', 'Unit' (Months, Days), 'Price (₹)', 'Joining fee (₹)' with 'Charged once, on a member’s first plan.', the 'PT plan' switch, 'Description (optional)', 'For sale?'
must_not: Values of the last edited plan left in the boxes

steps.action: Type 'Quarterly', 3, Months, 3000, leave the joining fee at 0, tap 'Save plan'
user_sees: 'Saving…', then the sheet closes
A new row: 'Quarterly', ₹3,000, '3 months', 'No joining fee', 'Sold today, runs until {date}'
must_not: Two rows from one tap
The price saved as ₹30 or ₹3,00,000
The sheet closing when the save failed

start: Owner of a new gym with no plans

steps.action: Open Plans
user_sees: 'No plans yet'
'Add your own, or start from a typical Indian gym price list and edit the numbers.'
Buttons '+ Add plan' and 'Use a starter price list'
must_not: A blank page

steps.action: Tap 'Use a starter price list'
user_sees: The button says 'Adding…' and is greyed
Five plans appear in the list
must_not: Ten plans after a double tap
Some plans missing with no word

steps.action: The internet drops part-way
user_sees: A red line ending 'Some plans may already be added. Check the list.'
must_not: A silent half list
A second tap adding the same plans again with the same names

start: Owner adds another kind of plan: a personal-training pack

steps.action: Tap '+ Add plan', type the name, duration and price, switch 'PT plan' on
user_sees: 'Personal training with a set number of sessions. Sold on top of their gym plan.'
Boxes 'PT sessions' (12, 'How many sessions this plan includes.') and 'Trainer (optional)'
must_not: The PT boxes shown while the switch is off

steps.action: Type 10 sessions and a trainer name, tap 'Save plan'
user_sees: The row shows a PT line under the name with the sessions and the trainer
must_not: The plan saved as a normal plan
A trainer name saved after the switch was turned off

start: Owner on the 'Add plan' sheet, wrong input

steps.action: Leave the name empty (or one letter) and tap 'Save plan'
user_sees: Under 'Plan name': 'Give the plan a name.'
must_not: A nameless plan saved

steps.action: Type 0, 121, 1.5 or 1e2 as the duration
user_sees: 'Duration must be a whole number between 1 and 120.'
must_not: A plan of 100 months from 1e2
A plan of 0 days

steps.action: Leave the price empty or type letters
user_sees: 'The price looks wrong. Type it again.'
must_not: A plan saved at ₹0 from an empty box

steps.action: Type letters as the joining fee
user_sees: 'The joining fee looks wrong. Type it again.'
must_not: The fee quietly saved as 0

steps.action: With 'PT plan' on, type 0 sessions
user_sees: 'PT sessions must be a whole number between 1 and {max}.'
must_not: A PT pack with no sessions

steps.action: Add a second plan with a name that is already used
user_sees: unknown: no duplicate-name check is visible on this sheet
must_not: Two plans the desk cannot tell apart when selling

steps.action: Tap 'Cancel' with text typed
user_sees: The sheet closes, nothing saved
must_not: A half-saved plan

start: Owner with a plan that members already bought

steps.action: Tap 'Edit' on the plan
user_sees: Sheet 'Edit plan' with the saved values
'A new price is used only for new sales. Memberships already sold keep their old price.'
must_not: Empty boxes
A price shown in paise

steps.action: Change the price and tap 'Save plan'
user_sees: The row shows the new price
must_not: Dues or receipts of memberships already sold change
The plan moves to another place in the list

steps.action: Edit again, set 'For sale?' to 'Not for sale (hidden when selling)', save
user_sees: The row gets a 'Not for sale' pill
must_not: The plan is deleted
Members on the plan lose it
The plan still offered when selling

steps.action: Edit again, set 'For sale?' back to 'For sale', save
user_sees: The pill is gone and the plan can be sold again
must_not: A second copy of the plan

steps.action: Edit a PT plan and switch 'PT plan' off, save
user_sees: The PT line under the name is gone
must_not: Old sessions or trainer still saved on the plan

start: Desk person signed in, gym with plans

steps.action: Open Plans
user_sees: Title 'Plans', subtitle 'What you sell, and for how much'
Every plan with its price, duration, joining fee line and run-until date
'Not for sale' on retired plans
must_not: A '+ Add plan' button
An 'Edit' button on any row
An empty column where Edit would be

start: Desk person on a gym with no plans, or trying to change one

steps.action: Open Plans on a gym with no plans
user_sees: 'No plans yet'
'Ask your gym owner to add the plans you sell.'
must_not: '+ Add plan'
'Use a starter price list'

steps.action: Look for any way to change a price
user_sees: No button, no link, no sheet
must_not: The desk changes a price or retires a plan

start: Desk person has Plans open while the owner edits on another device

steps.action: The owner changes a price and retires a plan; the desk person refreshes
user_sees: The new price, and 'Not for sale' on the retired plan
must_not: The old price sold at the desk

steps.action: The owner makes the plan for sale again; the desk person refreshes
user_sees: The pill is gone
must_not: The pill stays until sign-out
